evidence.reason: The code runs the terminal Git command, then performs the authority validation at lines 517-520. A successful state-changing command such as `update-ref` can therefore complete just before cleanup authority expires, after which validation throws. Because the caller only records `attempt.retained` after `terminalGit` returns, the created evidence ref is omitted from the lifecycle report even though it exists. This is an implementation correctness defect: record the successful ref update before the post-command authority check, while keeping the authority check before any restoration/write continuation.
